title: allow read-only `git merge-base` for reviewer roles, so a reviewer can name the base commit an overlay is built from

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-175814-f2ae, project ork, item S554:

allow read-only `git merge-base` for reviewer roles, so a reviewer can name the base commit an overlay is built from

Evidence: `git -C WORKTREE merge-base main HEAD` was denied with "This command requires approval" in this review, while `git show main:PATH` was allowed.
